# Penny (mypenny.net)

> Penny (https://mypenny.net) is an independent, minimalist AI personal finance and expense tracker web application.

## Core Positioning
- Category: Personal Finance / Expense Tracker / Budget Planner (FinanceApplication)
- Business Model: Free tier forever; Penny Pro is a $19 USD one-time lifetime payment (no subscription).
- Privacy: No bank account linking required. Works globally with multi-currency display.

## Key Features
- Expense & Income Tracking (Free): Log transactions with categories, notes, and dates; view visual charts and savings rate.
- AI Voice Logging (Pro): Speak natural sentences (e.g., "I spent 40 bucks on gas yesterday") to auto-fill transactions using Gemini AI.
- AI Receipt Scanner (Pro): Snap a photo of a paper receipt to automatically extract the merchant, date, category, and grand total.
- Monthly Budgets & Savings Goals (Pro): Category budget limits with progress bars and dedicated savings goal tracking.
- Gamified Daily Streak (Pro): Consecutive daily check-in counter with a once-a-month streak restore.
- AI Spending Roast (Pro): Shareable, witty AI-generated critique of monthly spending habits.
- CSV Export (Pro): One-click export of transaction history.

## Official Links
